learning_outcomes.text: understand the essential content of concrete or abstract subjects in written and oral texts
give an oral presentation in front of an audience
obtain certification of a minimum B2 level of the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) in written and oral comprehension
master English grammar at minimum B2 level
be able to present a technical or topical subject in a limited time
be able to obtain certification of minimum B2 level oral and written comprehension skills

syllabus_topics: revision of commonly tested grammar skills and vocabulary
exercises and corrections for each part of the TOEFL test
bibliography: J. Marcelin, F. Faivre, C. Garner, M. Ratie, Le Robert et Nathan Grammaire de l’Anglais. Nathan, 2009
R. Wyatt, Check your English vocabulary for TOEFL®, 4th edition. Bloomsbury, 2012.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
